blocks.caption: Field wear and flags: the mark at small and large scale

blocks.heading: One mark, many surfaces
blocks.body:
Vests, hard hats, and flags use the same lightning-R mark in light and dark versions, so the brand reads clearly on site.

The layouts pair real installer photography with short, confident headlines.

items.title: The Renergy Hub — Brand Identity System
items.overview:
A solar company needs to look trustworthy on a rooftop, on a billboard, and on a phone screen. This identity carries one lightning-R mark and a green and black palette across field gear, flags, and outdoor ads.

The line "We make energy simple, smart, and sustainable" sets the tone for every layout.
items.description: Full brand rollout for a solar energy company: logo mark, safety wear, banners, and outdoor billboard creative.

blocks.caption: Hard hat and carry bag with the ABJO mark

items.title: ABJO Properties & Surveying — Brand Assets
items.overview: Surveyors work outdoors, so the brand has to be seen from a distance. High-visibility colours and a bold ABJO wordmark carry the identity from vests to hard hats to print.
items.description: Field and corporate branding for a land surveying and property services company.

items.overview: Social content for a solar company has to educate and sell at the same time. These flyers and carousels turn topics like blackouts, fuel costs, and battery storage into quick, scannable posts.
items.description: Recurring flyers and carousels that turn solar ideas into simple visual stories.
